sample_pixels: sample pixels from image frames with optional boolean mask for valid pixel selection
random_sample: randomly sample pixel indices across frames and image dimensions for ray tracing
get_batch_data: retrieve sampled depth, ray direction, pose, and normal data for selected pixel indices
stratified_sample: generate stratified random depth samples between min and max depth along camera rays
sample_along_rays: sample 3D points along camera rays using stratified sampling with optional surface-aware offsets
